small_features.title: Implement MiniMax text-to-music Audio node
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Users can turn lyrics or connected script text into one playable audio outcome node from a Script-style inline Audio composer on the canvas, with backend-confirmed MiniMax provider/model evidence and honest local-preview labeling.
acceptance_criteria: Audio source nodes expose a Script-style inline composer for music style prompt and lyrics text under the selected Audio node.
Lyrics can be typed manually and can be seeded from connected upstream script/storyboard output when available.
Generate posts to the local FastAPI backend and never exposes MiniMax credentials in frontend code.
Backend MiniMax config uses MINIMAX_API_KEY, MINIMAX_BASE_URL, MINIMAX_MUSIC_MODEL, and optional MINIMAX_HTTPS_PROXY, defaulting the model to music-2.6-free.
Provider code posts to the MiniMax music_generation API with prompt, lyrics, output_format, audio_setting, lyrics_optimizer, and is_instrumental fields.
A successful generation creates or updates one deterministic audio outcome node on the canvas with a single audio output port.
The audio outcome node renders browser playback controls from a returned URL or hex/base64 audio data and displays provider/model evidence.
Unavailable Audio-node functions are explicitly labeled through visible not-implemented or no-persistence messages.
Verification covers backend provider/route tests, frontend tests, typecheck/build, and rendered interaction or E2E evidence.

small_features.title: Make Audio node self-contained with MiniMax music-2.6-free hex output
small_features.user_visible_behavior: Audio source nodes generate or upload playable audio directly on the selected Audio node. When current audio exists, the inline AI box switches to Edit audio mode.
acceptance_criteria: MiniMax provider defaults match the domestic free-tier shape: api.minimaxi.com music_generation endpoint, model music-2.6-free, output_format hex, sample_rate 44100, bitrate 256000, and mp3 format.
Empty Audio nodes generate from connected lyrics plus the inline natural-language music prompt through local FastAPI only.
Generated audio updates the selected Audio source node in place and renders browser audio controls on that node.
Audio generation no longer creates a separate Audio outcome node.
Generated or uploaded Audio node previews expose a visible local download action.
Audio upload updates the selected Audio source node locally and is labeled not persisted.
Existing audio switches the inline composer to Edit audio mode.
Feature 5 Image node and Feature 9 Video node behavior remain preserved.
Browser E2E must use the live MiniMax route; if provider/account issues occur, testing pauses instead of using a mock.

small_features.title: Complete Audio node AI edit with MiniMax cover reference
small_features.user_visible_behavior: When an Audio node already has generated or uploaded audio, the inline AI box runs Edit audio through local FastAPI using the current audio as a MiniMax music-cover-free reference, then replaces the selected Audio node with the edited playable result.
acceptance_criteria: Music generation contracts accept optional reference audio URL or base64 fields.
FastAPI maps existing-audio edit requests to MiniMax music-cover-free with audio_url or audio_base64.
The frontend derives a reference from generated hex audio, uploaded data URLs, base64 audio, or remote audio URLs.
Edit audio calls the local FastAPI backend and never calls MiniMax from the browser.
A successful edit replaces the selected Audio source node output in place with playable audio controls and a Download action.
The normal edit path no longer shows an AI audio editing not-implemented message.
Browser E2E covers empty-node generation followed by existing-audio edit through the live MiniMax route.
